arguments.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this adult cartoon mermaid sprite. Image 1 is the existing drawing to preserve. Image 2 is its exact original pose reference, whose red/white stippling is diagnostic skin coloring. Give her a playful, warm smiling face with softly parted lips and amused bright eyes. Relax the worried brow and lift the cheeks naturally. Keep the right-facing swimming profile and every body/arm/hair/water shape. Preserve her established adult identity, golden-blonde hair, turquoise band, tan skin, opaque green swimsuit top and green mermaid tail wherever visible. Her mood should read as happy and playful, never worried, sad or stoic. Keep the cel-shaded linework, source-facing direction, limb ownership, proportions, occlusion and thin cyan/white water strokes. Do not invent hidden anatomy or add scenery. Output one complete sprite with genuine transparent background and comfortable clear padding on all sides, no checkerboard, text or ground.
